problem.text: The chat example previously fixed multiline input at startup, offered no interactive context reset, and copied only the last code block.

reasoning.text: The change keeps interactive state in main and passes the current multiline setting to input helpers. Commands are handled before prompt insertion and generation, so toggling input or clearing history does not create a model turn.

impact.text: Users gain /mli, /clear and /cc N without restarting the loaded model. The helper signatures gain required arguments; whole-parent-tree literal searches found only the chat loop's calls, which the patch updates.

source_notes.text: Closed discussions provide context rather than an established motivation: #6, “No ROCm runtime is found, using ROCM_HOME='/usr'”, reports startup failure; #12, “Qwen2.5 Coder 0.5B Instruct | ValueError: Unsupported type in stop_conditions”, concerns prompt-mode selection; #22, “OpenAI compatible API example”, proposes an API endpoint. Their relationship here is inferred only from references to examples/chat.py, not the new commands. #38, “Error converting nvidia/Llama-3_1-Nemotron-Ultra-253B-v1”, concerns conversion tensor dimensions rather than chat controls.

limitations: No interactive terminal, clipboard backend or model generation was executed. The Python check transcribes parsing and indexing only.
Literal caller searches do not establish compatibility for external consumers or dynamically resolved calls.

chapters.title: Interactive chat controls and indexed code-block copying

claims.text: /mli toggles a local boolean initialized from args.multiline. Both basic and rich output modes already select read_input_ptk; that helper now forwards the live boolean to prompt_toolkit. read_input_console likewise uses it to choose stdin.read versus input; read_input_rich accepts it but still calls Prompt.ask without using it.

/clear replaces the conversation list with an empty list. Subsequent tokenization formats the retained system prompt with the new conversation; the command does not reload the model, explicitly clear generator cache, or erase the separately stored last response used by /cc.

Command dispatch now splits on literal spaces and matches the first token. /cc parses the second token as an integer, falling back to 1 on parsing failure. The helper finds complete triple-backtick blocks with a newline after the opening fence, strips the selected contents and copies them. Positive N counts backward: 1 means the last block; values exceeding the block count clamp to the first block. No matches return None before indexing.

A standard-library transcription with two blocks returned the last block for /cc, the first for /cc 2 and /cc 99, and the last for /cc with two spaces before 2. Thus the literal-space parser does not treat repeated spaces as a single separator.

findings.description: The new code-block selector bounds only positive overflow, allowing nonpositive indices to select unexpected blocks or raise an uncaught IndexError.
findings.trigger: Enter /cc -2 after a response containing exactly two matched code blocks; /cc 0 also exposes the missing lower bound.
findings.expected_behavior: Reject or normalize nonpositive block numbers without terminating the chat loop.
findings.actual_behavior: With two blocks, -2 becomes list index 2 and raises IndexError; 0 becomes index 0 and selects the first block. The caller catches integer-conversion errors only, not helper failures.

verification.description: Whole-parent-tree search found main's /cc branch as the sole literal helper caller. The changed branch forwards parsed negative integers without validation, so the issue reaches interactive chat in either output mode.
verification.limits: External and dynamically resolved callers are not covered.

verification.description: Transcribed the regex, command parsing, upper clamp and list indexing for two fenced blocks; observed IndexError for /cc -2 and first-block selection for /cc 0.
verification.limits: Did not execute the repository helper, clipboard operation or complete chat application.

annotation.summary: Adds runtime multiline toggling, conversation clearing and numbered code-block copying to the chat example; nonpositive copy indices remain unchecked.
